overclaims: Shows weekly users rising steadily, from 500M in March 2025 to 700M in August and 800M in October. No usage drop.
Big-tech revenue was still rising in mid-2025.
The consequent is not scored because the antecedent did not occur.
checks.note: The evidence explanations overstate the sources. August usage was close to 700M; three observations cannot establish steady growth or exclude intervening declines. Microsoft's quarter does not establish big-tech revenue overall. The packet does not establish that the antecedent never occurred. The rationale and limitations correctly acknowledge these limits, but the evidence explanations must also do so.
